comments.author: Montador
comments.body:
No one makes a living from doing adventure quests and selling the items. The repeatable quests (Amulet of the Sun, Alexander sword, Labarna sword, Richard armor, etc) are too random and spawn infrequently to be a main source of income. Supplemental income, sure. I sell those items whenever I see the quests but that is infrequently.

Savvia is farming unrepeatable adventure quests that give the best swords in the game by using people who have never done the quests before. He is certainly imaginative in his approach and it was a surprise to me when I heard of someone doing this. I give quests like these away for free; he charges a ton of money.
